comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This map comes from the Treasure archives of San Francisco (North American language or translation notes/dictionary required to read).

Pre-Requirement: Discover Port Royal (see page for details)

Map discovery point is located due east of the Pointed Boulder landmark, and a bit to the north. You should easily see the sparkle icon on your survey map, as well as the discovery 'column of light' marker when using the map as an item. Yields:

Pirate's Boots x1

See its page for details.
